notes: LAUNCH-CRITICAL CHECK CONFIRMED (Scenario 22, Layer C boundary, part 4 of 4, final scenario of the run): completes the Layer C decision-threshold boundary suite (19: 44=reject, 20: 45=hold+CTA, 21: 64=hold, 22: 65=accept).
